platform.label: Destination
platform.hint: The ideal format is applied to the project. Preview and export follow.

limits.note: Limits published by the platforms, shown for guidance only: they change without notice. A duration in red exceeds what the destination accepts.

aspect.label: Image format
aspect.hint: The thumbnail shows how much of a phone screen it fills.

custom.label: Custom format
custom.hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} pixels. Sides are rounded to an even number, as the video encoder requires.

import.label: Automatic import
import.hint: These settings apply to every imported image, so you don't have to fix them one by one.
import.autoRotateHint: A landscape photo in a vertical frame (or the reverse) is turned a quarter turn to fill the screen better.
import.autoZoomHint: Zooms just enough to fill the gap left around the image. No effect in "Fill" mode, which already overflows.
import.autoCenterHint: Frames on the most detailed area — often the face in a portrait. Analysed on your device, without face recognition.
import.note: These are starting points: every shot stays editable afterwards in the Edit panel.

guides.label: Preview guides
guides.hint: These guides change nothing in the video: they only appear in the preview, to help you frame.
guides.framingHint: Outlines the shot on the preview and reports what will be cropped or left empty. Hidden by default, because a shot in "Fill" mode always overflows a little.

background.label: Background
background.hint: Visible around a shot that doesn't fill the frame. Blur reuses the image itself instead of leaving black bars.

output.label: Output
output.hint: Dimensions of the exported file at high quality. Other tiers keep this format.
